description: Client-side script for auto-loading project items on scroll, handling review project filtering, and auto-submitting search forms in a web application.

methods.name: scroll event handler
methods.description: Loads more project items when scrolling reaches the bottom of the page.

methods.name: submit event handler for form.form-search
methods.description: Adds hidden input for review filtering if applicable before form submission.

methods.name: change event handler for input, select
methods.description: Automatically submits the form when search inputs change.
